qa_pair.question: Using the Census International Trade Data API's exports/hs dataset, what was the total value of U.S. exports (ALL_VAL_MO), across all countries and all Harmonized System commodities combined, for January 2013? Answer with the exact dollar figure as a plain integer, no commas or currency symbol.

Look up the Census CTY_CODE values for Guatemala and Belize, then use the exports/hs dataset to find each country's total value of U.S. exports (ALL_VAL_MO) for January 2013. What is Guatemala's value minus Belize's value, in dollars? Answer as a plain integer.

Using the exports/hs dataset with SUMMARY_LVL=CGP for June 2013, which of these four world regions had the highest year-to-date export value (ALL_VAL_YR): Europe, Asia, Australia and Oceania, or Africa? Answer with the region name exactly as it appears in the CTY_NAME field (all capital letters).
According to the exports/hs dataset, what was the monthly export value (ALL_VAL_MO) from the United States to Saint Pierre and Miquelon in June 2013? Answer as a plain integer, in dollars.

Using the exports/enduse dataset at the 1-digit End-Use aggregation level (COMM_LVL=EU1), what was the total U.S. export value (ALL_VAL_MO) for End-Use code "0" in January 2013? Answer as a plain integer, in dollars.

Using the imports/hs dataset at the 2-digit HS aggregation level (COMM_LVL=HS2) for January 2013, which single 2-digit HS commodity code among 01, 02, 03, and 04 had the highest general import value (GEN_VAL_MO)? Answer with just the 2-digit code.

Using the exports/hs dataset with the DF (Domestic/Foreign) parameter for January 2013, across all countries and all commodities, what was the value of foreign exports (DF=2, i.e. re-exports of foreign-origin merchandise), in dollars (ALL_VAL_MO)? Answer as a plain integer.

In the Census International Trade Data API, which dataset is broken out by U.S. state (instead of customs district) and is limited to 2-, 4-, and 6-digit HS codes only, with no 10-digit detail, to protect respondent confidentiality? Give the short dataset code exactly as used in the API path (e.g. "hs", "naics").
What is the Census Bureau's CTY_CODE grouping code that represents the "European Union" as a country grouping in the International Trade Data API?

For January 2013, using the exports/hs dataset broken out by country (CTY_CODE, CTY_NAME, ALL_VAL_MO), which single country was the largest destination for total U.S. exports that month? Answer with the country name exactly as returned in the CTY_NAME field.
